cells: MATHEMATICS & TECHNOLOGY  |  Explain WHY, show understanding, communicate precisely
This is not an extra compulsory section of an IA. Ask ONE purposeful question when a mathematical technique or software calculation is actually used; offer the full checklist at review.

Course-specific mathematical depth matters: AI SL and AA SL can both use modelling/statistics, but the student must show understanding, relevance and suitable depth. A few techniques well-used often beats a long list.

When a calculator, spreadsheet, regression tool or code produces an answer, briefly name the method, give its purpose, explain what was entered if needed, and interpret the output. No click-by-click instructions.
Typeset equations cleanly (equation editor/maths tools). Use '=' for exact equality and '≈' for rounded estimates. Define symbols and units on first appearance. Report defensible precision.

Give extra explanation when a method is outside the familiar course; do not write a textbook guide to routine arithmetic/plotting. If unfamiliar or mismatched mathematics is central, consult a teacher.
